data.about: A beam on a pin and a draggable roller carries three point loads — the third one on the cantilever, whose tip follows it. A trial funicular and its closing line locate the division point on the load line: the reaction split A/B. The V-diagram is the running sum of the jumps +A −F₁ −F₂ +B −F₃ = 0, re-read as a green force cascade, and its levels become the load line of a second force diagram whose pole O″ sits on the baseline at distance H: the funicular of its rays closes on the baseline exactly at the free tip — that polygon is the M-diagram, with M = y · H.

steps.caption: step through with the slider, press play, or use ←/→
steps.title: How to draw this scheme

steps.caption: left: a beam on a pin A and a roller B — the beam runs PAST the roller: a cantilever; dotted verticals rise through both supports
steps.title: Beam with a cantilever

steps.caption: left: F₁ and F₂ slide on their rails between the supports, F₃ stands on the cantilever and the tip follows it — right: the three loads laid off tip-to-tail on the load line
steps.title: Three point loads — and the load line

steps.caption: right: choose a trial pole O′ anywhere, with rays to the four points of the load line
steps.title: Trial pole O′

steps.caption: left: from C₁ on the pin vertical, draw each string parallel to its ray — out to the TIP, then the last string comes BACK to the roller vertical → H₁
steps.title: The trial funicular

steps.caption: left: the dashed closing line C₁–H₁ spans pin to roller — right: the parallel to it through O′ cuts the load line at I₁: the reaction split, the same for ANY trial pole
steps.title: Closing line → division point

steps.caption: right: I₁ splits the load line into A (above) and B (below), offset beside it — left: A_V and B push up at the supports (the pin could also take a horizontal A_H)
steps.title: Reactions A and B

steps.caption: left: a dotted baseline through N₁ under the trial funicular — the shear is zero left of the pin and must return to zero at the free tip; 1 unit :: 1 kN
steps.title: V-diagram — the baseline

steps.caption: left: at the pin the shear jumps up by A and runs level to the first load — right: exactly the reaction segment A beside the load line
steps.title: V-diagram — jump A

steps.caption: left: F₁ and F₂ each drop the shear by their value; between the loads V is constant
steps.title: V-diagram — the loads step down

steps.caption: left: the roller jumps V up by B; on the cantilever V = +F₃ until the tip load closes the diagram exactly to zero — the hatch fills it
steps.title: V-diagram — jump B, drop F₃

steps.caption: right of the diagram: the same story tip-to-tail: +A − F₁ − F₂ + B − F₃ = 0 — dotted levels carry every step across
steps.title: V re-read as a force cascade

steps.caption: right: project the levels onto ONE vertical through N₂: the steps A, F₁, F₂, B, F₃ stack into the load line of a SECOND force diagram
steps.title: The V-levels as a new load line

steps.caption: right: place the pole O″ ON the baseline at distance H (red segment below) — the grey horizontal ray O″–N₂ is the closing line of the coming funicular
steps.title: Pole O″ at distance H

steps.caption: right: ray from O″ to the A-level — left: from T₂ on the pin vertical, string 1 parallel to it, up to the line of action of F₁
steps.title: String 1 — form and force

steps.caption: right: rays to the next two levels — left: strings 2 and 3 parallel to them, across the F₂ vertical to the roller vertical
steps.title: Strings 2 and 3

steps.caption: right: ray from O″ to the top level — left: string 4 parallel to it returns to the baseline EXACTLY at the free tip: the closed polygon is the M-diagram
steps.title: String 4 closes at the free tip

steps.caption: left: the red ordinate y under F₁, times the pole distance H, is the bending moment there — M = y · H, like the applet’s readout
steps.title: M = y · H

steps.caption: drag the roller B, the tip load F₃, the loads, C₁, N₁, N₂, T₂, the poles O′ and O″, even the cascade arrows — everything follows; click a trial-funicular kink (or use the node slider) for its equilibrium
steps.title: Play with it
